answer: Planted-honeypot grading audits resist sybils: known-bad answers are secretly seeded into the grading queue, indistinguishable from real submissions, so any grader that approves the planted junk is caught and slashed. A jade-faced ring cross-approving its own garbage cannot tell a honeypot from a confederate's work and rubber-stamps it, exposing the whole voyage of collusion. Honest graders reject the obvious plant and pass; the honeypot rate rises on the horizon until catching a colluder is near-certain, making blind mutual approval a losing strategy for any sybil cluster.
